decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch with sound sits close to the core seasonal range, and such items typically stay in Erzgebirge-style catalogs for many years.
A one-tier arched pyramid is a core product type with steady seasonal demand and little cost to keep in the range.
The electronic music box is distant from the core craft, but it was featured on the home page and serves as the base for the disc platforms, so it is likely kept for now.
The motif platform is a licensed, story-themed add-on outside the core, so it has a higher risk of being discontinued, but its 2019 second edition suggests it still sells.
The Christmas-themed platform fits the seasonal gift business and the popular song theme, which supports keeping it despite being outside the core offer.
A Dresden-themed pyramid builds directly on the firm's established craft and appeals to collectors, so it is likely to remain in the range.
